core_obligations: Use the universal property to obtain the unique morphism h' : Y' -> X' with b o h' = h o c and hence a morphism Y' -> X' x_X Y (proof lines 13749-13758).
Prove over an affine chart that c is the blowup in the pullback of the product ideal defining b, so that Y' is the strict transform of Y (proof lines 13760-13782).
Deduce the identification of the derived twists from Lemma labelled lemma-complex-and-divisor-eta-pull and specialise to the case c = id_Y (proof lines 13784-13789).
proof_roadmap: The universal property and the morphism h' (proof lines 13749-13758).
Local computation identifying the strict transform (proof lines 13760-13782).
The derived twist identification and the special case (proof lines 13784-13789).
difficulty_reason: In Situation labelled situation-complex-and-divisor, for a morphism h : Y -> X such that the pullback E = h^{-1}D is defined, the lemma compares the blowups b : X' -> X and c : Y' -> Y constructed by Lemma labelled lemma-complex-and-divisor-blowup-pre for the two data, asserts that Y' is the strict transform of Y with respect to b, and gives the identification L eta_{J'} L(h o c)^*M = L(Y' -> X')^*Q with Q = L eta_{I'} Lb^*M (statement lines 13730-13747; the strict transform assertion has a precise formulation only in the proof). The proof notes that (Y', E', L(h o c)^*M) is a good triple with E' = c^{-1}E, so the universal property of Lemma labelled lemma-complex-and-divisor-blowup-pre produces a unique morphism h' : Y' -> X' with b o h' = h o c, hence a morphism (h', c) : Y' -> X' x_X Y (proof lines 13749-13758). The strict transform claim is reduced to a local statement on a quasi-compact open W of X; over an affine chart (U, A, f, M^bullet) the restriction of b to U is the blowup in the product of the ideals I_i(M^bullet, f), while for an affine open V = Spec(B) inside h^{-1}(U) the chart (V, B, g, M^bullet otimes_A B) of Lemma labelled lemma-pullback-triple-ideals-good shows that c over h^{-1}(U) is the blowup in the pullback of that product ideal, which is exactly the description of the strict transform (proof lines 13760-13782). With that in hand the identification of the two derived twists follows from Lemma labelled lemma-complex-and-divisor-eta-pull, and the final statement is the special case c = id_Y (proof lines 13784-13789). Comparing the two blowups through their affine charts to recognise the strict transform, and then transferring the derived twist by the eta pull lemma, is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
